transport.title: Train to Manchester
transport.text: TransPennine Express and Northern Rail trains to Manchester Piccadilly take about 20 minutes and depart every 10 minutes daily. The station is between Terminals 2 and 3: about a 10-minute walk from Terminal 2 and about 5 minutes from Terminal 3. Lifts, escalators and moving walkways connect the terminals with the station; tickets are sold online, at machines and at the rail information desk.

storage.title: Baggage storage
storage.text: Excess Baggage Company offers short- and long-term baggage storage in Terminal 2 departures. Baggage wrapping and arrangements for domestic and international baggage delivery are also available for passengers departing from Terminal 2.

kids.title: Baby-changing rooms
kids.text: Baby-changing facilities are in or near the women’s toilets and have chairs for breastfeeding. Breastfeeding is permitted throughout the airport and is not restricted to these rooms.

wifi.title: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.text: The free _FreeWifi network offers up to 2 hours of access in each 24-hour period. You can connect from a phone, tablet or laptop; the service is also available in lounges and Runway Visitor Park.
